data.body:
Phase 1 RCA — CONFIRMED DEFECT.

Mechanism: the deterministic `plan_review_assemble_criteria` step can raise `CriteriaError` while loading the repository criteria overlay (`src/rebar/llm/plan_review/workflow_ops.py:197-252`). The workflow interpreter records every scripted exception only as a string (`src/rebar/llm/workflow/interpreter.py:419-511`). After coach/verify recovery, `produce_plan_review_verdict` treats every remaining failed workflow as an LLM-finder failure (`src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py:235-243`) and passes it to `_degraded_plan_review_verdict`, which unconditionally stamps `coverage.llm_unavailable=True` (`src/rebar/llm/workflow/plan_review_recovery.py:303-340`). That source-blind tail is the direct root cause; exception identity loss is contributing, not sufficient.

Discriminating runtime proof on current origin/main c6f20ceb0b: an ephemeral full-gate probe injected `CriteriaError("phase1 malformed-overlay sentinel")` from `registry.effective_criteria`. The recorder showed failed frame `review@then/assemble`, kind `scripted`, and zero executed agent/batch frames, yet the public verdict was INDETERMINATE with full DET coverage, `llm_ran=False`, and `llm_unavailable=True`. A genuine preflight `LLMUnavailableError` control remained unavailable; a healthy FakeRunner control returned PASS with `llm_ran=True` and no unavailable flag. Injecting a typed `CriteriaError` directly as `RunResult.error` still produced `llm_unavailable=True`, proving the broad tail itself is sufficient. A same-frame identity differential showed CriteriaError, RuntimeError, and LLMUnavailableError all emerge from the generic interpreter as identical strings, confirming the enabling information loss. The ephemeral probe was deleted; the worktree is clean.

Legitimacy: DEFECT. Original epic jira-reb-687 explicitly replaces the opaque single-error collapse and scopes the unavailable/disposition behavior to LLM failures. `docs/config.md:335-365`, ADR 0040, and gate_dispatch’s own module contract likewise describe only LLM call/tier failures as `llm_unavailable`. A local criteria/config parse failure is not an LLM failure.

Caller-dependency gate: expected post-fix behavior is fail-closed INDETERMINATE with DET coverage and a distinct installed-build/config-fault diagnostic; genuine preflight and mid-run LLM outages remain unchanged. `_degraded_plan_review_verdict` has only those two genuine outage callers plus the generic failed tail. Splitting only a structured CriteriaError marker from the tail finds no caller relying on the mislabel.
